title: SatMend: LLM Agents for Automated Software Repair in Satellite Constellations with Intermittent Ground Contact
abstract: arXiv:2611.29227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Satellite constellations rely on onboard software to sustain services across cooperating spacecraft. Maintaining this software requires handling related component versions and different failure causes while delivering repairs through intermittent ground contact. Automated software repair in satellite constellations remains underexplored, particularly the coordination of repairs across related versions with verified onboard recovery under intermittent ground contact. To address this gap, we propose SatMend, a software repair method driven by ground-based large language model (LLM) agents. SatMend organizes related versions into persistent sessions to retain diagnostic context and combines source and runtime evidence to select code repair or state recovery actions. It validates each version separately and submits ready candidates during continued repair, allowing ground preparation to overlap with onboard delivery and verification. Experim

translated_title: SatMend：面向间歇性地面联系卫星星座的基于LLM智能体的自动化软件修复
translated_abstract: 卫星星座依赖星载软件来维持跨协作航天器提供的服务。维护这些软件需要处理相互关联的组件版本和不同的故障原因，同时还要通过间歇性的地面联系来交付修复。卫星星座中的自动化软件修复目前仍未得到充分探索，尤其是在间歇性地面联系条件下，如何跨相关版本协调修复并进行经过验证的星载恢复。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SatMend，一种由地面大语言模型（LLM）智能体驱动的软件修复方法。SatMend将相关版本组织为持久会话以保留诊断上下文，并结合源代码与运行时证据来选择代码修复或状态恢复动作。它对每个版本分别进行验证，并在持续修复的过程中提交已就绪的候选版本，使地面准备工作能够与星载交付和验证并行进行。实验……
tldr: SatMend提出了一种由地面LLM智能体驱动的卫星星座自动化软件修复方法，通过持久会话保留诊断上下文、结合源码与运行时证据选择修复或状态恢复动作，并使地面修复准备与星载交付验证在间歇性地面联系下并行进行。
en_tdlr: SatMend introduces a ground-based LLM-agent-driven automated software repair approach for satellite constellations, which retains diagnostic context across related versions via persistent sessions, selects code repair or state recovery based on source and runtime evidence, and overlaps ground preparation with onboard delivery and verification under intermittent ground contact.
